text: Alchemy dev deploy can update the Worker while D1 migration fails on stale pre-auth data with a foreign-key constraint, leaving a partial deployment; add a preflight/transaction status warning and documented clean-stage recovery.
Auth tables were introduced in 0012_auth.sql before Drizzle journal tracking, so db:generate sees app-owned auth schema as four new tables and cannot safely generate later auth column changes.

Drizzle generate replayed unrelated chat-generation, chat-event, and hevy-set changes because migration metadata is out of sync; need an established baseline/reconciliation command so schema-only work generates only intended migrations.

reason: Fix requires reconciling Drizzle migration metadata, which repository policy forbids editing by hand.
Fix requires an authoritative Drizzle baseline/reconciliation workflow; no safe local repair exists.
Atomic Worker and D1 deployment behavior requires Alchemy platform support or an approved migration-recovery design.
